Author: The Enceladeum
Name: HOutfits
Punchline: Apply full sets to your character in Glamourer with a single click.
Description: Lists the game's complete named sets and applies a whole set or any single piece to your character through Glamourer, instead of picking each item from a dropdown.
Changelog: 0.4.0: adds a Loose gear tab that lists every wearable piece that isn't part of a set, plus facewear, as an icon grid you can filter by slot. Hover any icon for a large preview and click to apply just that piece; pieces that are the same gear sold once per role are collapsed into one tile (turn off "Hide duplicate looks" to see them all). The Outfit sets tab now also lists sets the game doesn't name, recovered by matching item names (untick "Include name-grouped sets" to see only the game's own), and its piece icons show the same large preview on hover. The search boxes now have a clear button.
